headline: Khaitan & Co, Dentons Link Legal, Hogan Lovells Cadwalader act on INOX Green Energy ₹300 crore QIP
sum: Inox Green Energy Services Limited has made a qualified institutions placement of equity shares aggregating to ₹300 crore. Khaitan & Co advised INOX Green Energy Services on this QIP.
detail: Inox Green Energy Services Limited has made a qualified institutions placement of equity shares aggregating to ₹300 crore. Khaitan & Co advised INOX Green Energy Services on this QIP. The transaction team consisted of Madhur Kohli (Partner), Vaibhav Mittal (Partner), Mainak Pal (Senior Associate), Siddharth Jain (Associate), Diya Vishwas Arora (Associate) and Harshita Sharma (Associate). Madhur Kohli, Vaibhav Mittal Dentons Link Legal and Hogan Lovells Cadwalader advised the Book Running Lead Manager, Emkay Global Financial Services Limited, on Indian and US law respectively.
